name: Folgoso de la Ribera (Spain)
description: Blue field with a broad white band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the upper hoist with a black bear rampant.
history: Municipal flag of Folgoso de la Ribera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
bear rampant at the upper hoist
